# Vendored animated icons

Vendored from `@animateicons/react@0.3.4` (MIT, Avijit Dey — https://github.com/Avijit07x/animateicons).
Self-contained (bundles `motion`; only needs React). Consumed via `components/icons/iconMap.ts`.
Tree-shaking ships only the icons referenced in the map. To refresh, re-copy `dist/lucide.js` + `dist/chunk-*.js` + `dist/lucide.d.ts` here.
